name: Natalia Silva

tale_of_tape.source: data/derived/fighters.json (64 in height, 65 in reach, Southpaw, born 1997-02-03); 125 lb at the UFC 332 weigh-in (Oct 2, 2026), where she won the vacant women's flyweight title over Wang Cong.

photo_coverage: Good and recent for the front of the face and the body: a title-belt studio headshot and cut-out (Oct 2026), a neutral frontal studio cut-out with loose hair, two freely licensed interview stills (frontal), UFC 315 and UFC 324 weigh-in photos, a high-resolution UFC 324 fight photo (three-quarter from below) and a UFC 332 celebration photo (Oct 2026). Missing: a true side profile, so nose projection and chin depth are estimated from three-quarter views.

face.shape: Oval to soft heart shape: broad, smooth forehead and moderately wide cheekbones tapering to a fairly narrow, rounded chin. Cheeks firm, with round apples when she smiles (she smiles in most photos).
face.jaw: Softly defined, not wide; the jawline runs smoothly from below the ears to the chin.
face.chin: Narrow-to-medium, rounded with a slightly pointed tip; average projection in three-quarter views.
face.cheekbones: Moderately high and wide; the upper cheeks lift and round strongly in her smile.
face.forehead: Broad and medium-high, smooth; with the hair braided back the hairline is gently rounded with no recession.

eyes.shape: Almond eyes with slightly heavy upper lids (lid crease partly hidden), outer corners level; they narrow to crescents when she smiles.
eyes.colour: Dark brown. Closest MakeHuman iris: brown.

eyebrows.shape: Gently arched with a soft peak about two-thirds out, tapering tails; groomed.
eyebrows.colour: Very dark brown, close to the hair (about #2a1d18).

nose.width: Medium bridge widening to a broad, rounded tip and moderately wide nostrils
nose.tip: Rounded and full, level to very slightly upturned

face.mouth_lips: Medium-width mouth; medium upper lip with a soft cupid's bow and a fuller lower lip. Very wide smile showing the upper teeth; at rest the lips are closed with a slight upturn at the corners.

ears.size: Small, close to the head; small gold hoop earrings in interviews.
ears.cauliflower_ear: None visible (both ears in the braided-hair photos look normal).

face.marks_scars: Some small acne marks and uneven texture on the cheeks and forehead (studio cut-out and headshot); no scars visible.

hair.style: Two looks. Fight night and title photos: tight cornrows running straight back from the hairline into a bun at the crown or back of the head (UFC 324, UFC 332, title headshot). Weigh-ins and media: worn loose as a dense mass of tight dark ringlet curls falling past the shoulders, parted slightly off-centre (yellow-kit cut-out, UFC 315 and UFC 324 weigh-ins).
hair.length_note: Curls hang to the shoulder blades (about 35-45 cm as they fall; longer stretched).
hair.colour_note: Near-black dark brown with warm brown glints where lit.
hair.avatar_choice: Fight look: scalp-hugging cornrow texture with a bun (ponytail01 shortened into a bun, tinted #2c1f19). Media look: no shipped curly-long proxy; afro01 tinted and shaped longer is the closest volume match.

skin.tone_hex_method: Plain RGB mean of the samples marked in_average (well-lit cheek/forehead patches; specular and heavily graded patches excluded); each sample is the mean of the 15th-85th luma-percentile pixels of the patch.
skin.tone_note: Medium tan, light-brown skin. The title headshot is graded strongly orange-red (#bc5d43) and was left out; the interview stills and the UFC 324 weigh-in read a little cooler (#bc826c to #bc9478). Aim between #c98868 and #cf8b6a.
skin.freckles_marks: Small acne marks on the cheeks; no body marks other than normal training bruises.

body.build: Compact, lean and athletic flyweight with noticeably muscular arms and shoulders and strong kicker's legs.
body.body_fat_note: Six-pack visible in the yellow-kit cut-out; tight waist.
body.shoulders: Moderately broad and rounded with well-defined deltoids.
body.chest: Athletic, small, under a sports bra or rash guard.
body.arms: Muscular for her size: high biceps peak and visible triceps when flexing (UFC 315 and UFC 324 weigh-ins); toned forearms.
body.legs_calves: Strong, defined quads with a teardrop above the knee, muscular calves; legs proportionate.
body.posture: Upright, relaxed, smiling; hands on hips or behind the back in posed shots.
body.notable: The constant wide smile, the curls versus cornrows switch, and the muscular arms are the main recognisable cues.

tattoos.description: None visible on arms, shoulders, torso or legs in the cut-outs, weigh-in and fight photos.

kit.fight_kit_recent: Black Venum short-sleeve rash guard with white speckle print down the centre, white UFC logo, black shorts (UFC 324, Jan 2026, and UFC 332, Oct 2026); red wrist tape at UFC 332.
kit.title_studio_kit: Black rash guard and shorts with gold Venum/crypto.com print panels (ESPN title cut-out).
kit.other: Yellow Venum Brazil-colour sports bra and shorts with green lettering (older cut-out); navy Venum sports set (UFC 315 ceremonial); red/black camo set (UFC 324 ceremonial).

stance_and_guard_observed.from_photos: UFC 324 photo: throwing a long left straight with her chin tucked behind the shoulder and the head off the centre line. Too few fight frames to set guard values; leave that to the scouting-based stance block.

morphs_extra_macro.note: Outside the requested list but in the shipped manifest; same neutral athletic values as the other women's sheets.

morphs_if_available.note: Ear targets are not in assets/embed/mh-manifest.json. Her ears are small and close to the head; if added, ears/l-ear-scale-decr and ears/r-ear-scale-decr about 0.1.

morphs_unavailable: Height: no heightUpF/heightDownF given (the research/assets.md height fit is for the male base); build at the female default and scale to 162.6 cm. Curls and cornrows need hair/texture work, not morphs. avatar3d.js reads the M macros from sheets; the F macros here document intent (muscleUpF 0.7 = clearly muscular but lighter than Zhang Weili's 0.8).

render_hints.skin_base: young_african_female or young_caucasian_female tinted toward #cf8b6a (pick whichever base keeps the warm golden-brown without going grey)
render_hints.hair: fight: cornrows + bun, #2c1f19; media: long tight curls

notes: Confidence: high for skin tone range, hair (both looks), eye colour, smile, build and the absence of tattoos; medium for nose projection and chin depth (no side profile found). Watch for: (1) broad rounded nose tip and wide nostrils on a medium-height bridge; (2) soft heart-shaped face with a narrow rounded chin; (3) arms and shoulders more muscular than a default female mesh; (4) fight hair is tight cornrows into a bun, not loose curls; (5) the title headshot is colour-graded too red for skin sampling. She is the current UFC women's flyweight champion (won Oct 3, 2026).
